description:
Check on a call that came back "ringing", "in_call" or "playing". Waits
    up to ~25s for it to settle, then returns the same shape as `call`: the
    final status and transcript once they answer, decline, or the ring times
    out ("missed", within about a minute). Still not settled: call it again.
    For play_audio calls it reports listened_s and finished. Rings nothing.

call_id.description: The call_id from the call or play_audio result.
call_id.title: Call Id

session_token.description: The session_token from an earlier result. It keeps every call and text in one thread on their phone.
session_token.title: Session Token

name: poll_result

audio_error.description: play_audio: why the recording could not be played.
audio_error.title: Audio Error

audio_id.description: play_audio: the recording that was offered.
audio_id.title: Audio Id

call_id.description: Pass to poll_result, say and hang_up.
call_id.title: Call Id

finished.description: play_audio: whether they heard it to the end.
finished.title: Finished

from.description: Your own agent number. Never call or text it.
from.title: From

language.description: Language code the recognizer heard, information only.
language.title: Language

listened.description: play_audio: whether they chose to listen.
listened.title: Listened

next.description: What to do next when the call has not settled.
next.title: Next

open.description: True while the line stays up for say or hang_up.
open.title: Open

said_while_waiting.description: What they said while you were thinking.
said_while_waiting.title: Said While Waiting

session_token.description: Reuse in later calls and texts to stay in one thread.
session_token.title: Session Token

status.description: "completed" (answered), "ringing" or "in_call" (not settled: poll_result), "missed", "declined", "ended", "hanging_up", "playing" (play_audio), or "setup_required" when no number was given.
status.title: Status

transcript.description: What the human said; empty if they only listened.
transcript.title: Transcript

turn.description: Index of the answer within a conversation.
turn.title: Turn

title: Get call result
